load_lvis_json: load LVIS annotations from a JSON file and return dataset records with images and annotations
register_dataset: register a single LVIS DensePose dataset with DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog using CocoDatasetInfo
register_datasets: register multiple LVIS DensePose datasets by iterating over an iterable of CocoDatasetInfo objects
combine_images_with_annotations: combine image metadata and annotation dicts into structured dataset records with bounding boxes and keypoints
maybe_add_keypoints: add keypoints from an annotation dict to an object dict, converting integer pixel indices to float coordinates
